{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.34

|gr1= RTD

|descr= Returns air density in given altitude. {{Feature|afm}}

|s1= [[airDensityRTD]] altitude

|p1= altitude: [[Number]]

|r1= [[Number]]
